اكتروا (form VIII)
# اِكْتَرَوْا (iktaraw) /ik.ta.raw/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِكْتَرَى (iktarā)
# اُكْتُرُوا (ukturū) /uk.tu.ruː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِكْتَرَى (iktarā)
# اِكْتَرُوا (iktarū) /ik.ta.ruː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِكْتَرَى (iktarā)
